LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My. No.: DS/GFG/L&L/5/2014/07. Land Min’s Ref No.: 4-3/12/2014/UD/239-A. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition, (amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for a public purpose.
